options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         Base model id or path (single-spec mode).
  --adapters ADAPTERS   LoRA adapter path for the after-SFT run.
  --label LABEL         Label for the single-spec run.
  --models-config MODELS_CONFIG
                        YAML list of {label, model, adapters?, backend?}
                        specs.
  --backend {claude,mock,openai,swift}
  --dataset DATASET
  --split SPLIT
  --bbox-format {xywh,xyxy}
                        Annotation convention of --dataset (default matches
                        DEFAULT_DATASET).
  --bbox-normalized, --no-bbox-normalized
                        Dataset bbox is 0-1 rather than pixels. Use --no-bbox-
                        normalized for a mirror that stores absolute pixels.
  --limit LIMIT
  --viewport VIEWPORT
  --coord-space {native_abs,normalized_1000,viewport_abs}
                        Global default. A spec in --models-config may override
                        it with `coord_space:` — a stock Qwen and an sft3
                        checkpoint answer in normalized_1000, an sft-v1/v2
                        checkpoint answers in viewport_abs, so a before/after
                        comparison MUST score each side in its own space.
  --parse-pattern PARSE_PATTERN
                        Override default regex(es); repeatable.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --max-pixels MAX_PIXELS
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --smoke-test          Run the no-model pipeline self-test and exit.
